question: Jitesh's brother-in-law Jagdish is also Suresh's father-in-law. How could Suresh's wife be related to Jitesh?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given: Jitesh's brother-in-law Jagdish is also Suresh's father-in-law.

Case 1) Jagdish is Jitesh's sister's brother

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53df02ecb4d4857a3cf105da6cba85464e8893cbef978538183dac1808b99ce2.png] 

Case 2) Jagdish is Jitesh's wife's brother.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6abb20c44ed8c2f2e8f78aa3fc02b86952de4245a74830fd5acbf10bf115a50b.png] 

Thus, in both cases, Suresh's wife is Jitesh's niece.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
